name: output-quiz
title: Predict the output
description: A code listing and a box for the output the reader expects it to print (or the value it returns); Check compares line by line, marks each line and then shows an explanation.

attempts.description: Checks allowed before the expected answer is shown; 0 = unlimited. A widget overrides it with data-attempts.

showExpected.description: When the expected lines appear next to the reader's: "end" (after the last allowed check, or on Show answer) or "wrong" (after every wrong check). A widget overrides it with data-show-expected.

trimTrailing.description: Ignore spaces and tabs at the end of each line. A widget overrides it with data-trim-trailing="true|false".

trimLeading.description: Ignore spaces and tabs at the start of each line (indentation). Override: data-trim-leading.

collapseSpaces.description: Treat any run of spaces and tabs inside a line as one space. Override: data-collapse-spaces.

ignoreBlankLines.description: Leave blank lines out of the comparison. Blank lines at the very end never count. Override: data-ignore-blank-lines.

caseSensitive.description: Compare letters with their case. Override: data-case-sensitive.

rows.description: Starting height of the answer box in lines (it grows as the reader types). Override: data-rows.

defaultLang.description: Language of a listing whose <pre> names none; empty = code-blocks' defaultLang, else plain text.

quizEvents.description: Also emit the core 'quiz:answer' event ({id, index: 0, correct}) once a widget is settled (right, out of tries, or answer shown), so progress features count it like a core quiz.

outputPrompt.description: Label of the answer box (output mode).

valuePrompt.description: Label of the answer field (value mode, data-mode="value").

outputPlaceholder.default: One line of output per line
outputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the answer box; empty = none.

valuePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the value field; empty = none.

revealLabel.description: Button that gives up and shows the expected answer.

resetLabel.description: Button that clears the answer and the tries.

attemptsMade.description: Status with unlimited tries, once the reader has checked; {used}.

empty.description: Shown when Check is pressed with an empty answer.

wrong.description: Verdict for a wrong output; {right}, {total} (expected lines), {given} (your lines).

lineCount.default: The output has a different number of lines.
lineCount.description: Added to the wrong verdict when the line counts differ; {total}, {given}.

outOfTries.default: No tries left. The expected answer is shown.
outOfTries.description: Verdict after the last wrong check.

yoursHeading.description: Column heading over the reader's lines.

expectedHeading.description: Column heading over the expected lines.

lineHeading.description: Accessible heading of the line-number column.

markHeading.description: Accessible heading of the right/wrong column.

wrongMark.description: Symbol on a line that differs.

rightLine.description: Screen-reader word for a matching line.

wrongLine.description: Screen-reader word for a line that differs.

missingLine.description: Shown in a cell where one side has no line.

blankLine.description: Shown for an empty line, so it is visible.

alsoAccepted.description: Value mode, when the answer is shown and several answers are accepted; {list}.
